shot: grounded low angle, camera does not move until the final beat's push-in
character: PIG: plump pink pig, deadpan heavy-lidded eyes, dusty builder's apron; trotters grip/sweep/count/pin; appetizing waddle-limp gait
cast: GOAT: shaggy grey-and-white goat, small stubby horns, blank chewing gaze; large, close to lens, never speaks
props: trough of kitchen scraps; torn palace blueprint pinned to a post, corner ripped and flapping; apron hem loose; burlap sack of construction rubble sits by the trough from the start
setting: yard by an unfinished house foundation, concrete slab

audio.delivery: male low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry unrushed flat deadpan, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: 5-part line, word-boundary splits, 4.0-4.8 syll/sec, breath only after part 1. «Копила»:ko-PI-la(2) «мусора»:MU-so-ra(1) «строительного»:stro-I-tel-no-vo(3). Nothing after 8.55
audio.lip_sync: pig talks like a person, mouth opens and closes clearly every syllable, voice is the pig's own, never a voice over
audio.sfx: wet chomping, satisfied grunt, loud burp, apron snap, paper tearing, goat bleat and chewing

timeline.a: silent. Snout buried in the trough, wet chomping, tail wagging hard; torn blueprint flaps on the post
silent. Waddle-limps one step sideways along the trough, snout still down, still chewing hard
silent. Snout snaps up out of the trough in one sharp jerk, a spray of scraps flies past the lens, grinning wide
silent. Grabs the apron hem with a trotter and yanks it hard across her snout in one sharp swipe, smearing more than cleaning
silent. Chest puffs, loud burp, apron snaps back to her side
steady. Both trotters haul the burlap sack onto her lap, straining, eyes flicking once to the blueprint
silent, real inhale, trotters still braced under the sack
steady. Peers into the sack, snout wrinkling at what's inside
steady, no pause. Grips the sack's corner, squeezing, rubble shifting inside
steady, no pause. Tips the sack hard, gravel crashes out in a heavy stream, dust bursting up
steady, no pause. Sack drops, thuds hard on the slab in a puff of dust; gaze slides down to the trough, landing on the last syllable
silent. Goat trots in from the right, beelines straight for the blueprint on the post
silent. Goat locks its teeth onto the torn corner, plants its hooves, rips the blueprint off the post whole in one pull, paper crumpling in its teeth
silent. Goat's flank brushes her shoulder passing; pig glances, shrugs, turns back to the trough
silent. Snout dips back into the trough, chomping resumes; goat behind her chews and swallows the last scrap of paper
timeline.cam: only camera move in the clip: slow push-in on her snout in the trough, ending the shot

must_appear: pig chomping snout-down in the trough; snout snapping up, scraps flying; apron swiped across her snout; the burp; sack hauled onto her lap and squeezed, gravel trickling out; goat ripping the blueprint off the post
negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low-key, dark scene, underexposed; second pig, second goat, other animals; duplicate trough, post, apron, or sack; floating objects, props stacked in tiers; camera movement besides the single push-in; cuts, jump cuts; extra limbs; human hands; costume changes; rushed delivery, slow speech, drawn-out delivery, pauses mid-sentence, speech after 8.60, foreign accent, English speech; subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, readable text on the blueprint
